scope: Real non-forced transformation, real worker in two processes and loopback HTTP API on the 9,249,545-contract cut
limits: No new SECOP download or analytics recalculation
No changed-row write workload; this cut has no pending transformation candidates
Latency/memory observations do not define an approved production SLA
Memory sampling covers the harness/API process, not all PostgreSQL and recovered-worker processes
Only job-status HTTP requests were sampled in this trial; costly search had a separate prior benchmark
No packet-loss or upstream SECOP HTTP failure was injected
Logs without a job association were not retroactively attributed; only verification-created rows were cleaned

terminated_backend.query:
SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM (SELECT raw_secop.id AS raw_secop_id 
FROM raw_secop LEFT OUTER JOIN contratos_procesados ON raw_secop.id = contratos_procesados.raw_secop_id 
WHERE raw_secop.id <= 9249545 AND (contratos_procesados.id IS NULL OR raw_secop.sincronizado_en > contratos_procesados.procesado_en)) AS anon_1

code_scope: The live processes loaded the pinned-connection/fencing correction before the interrupted-log association, empty-candidate shortcut and transaction-local memory changes were added. Those later changes are covered by separate tests and CI, not this running trial.
